# Drop-in replacements for retiring APIs, plus data tools

> Keep code working after Perspective, Azure Content Moderator and whisper-1 shut down: same requests, same JSON. Plus App Store reviews and Woolworths data.

## Pages

- [Stop AI coding agents installing hallucinated packages](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/ai-agent-hallucinated-packages/): Block npm and PyPI installs of names that do not exist (slopsquatting) in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor, then check APIs in your exact version.
- [Stop AI coding agents claiming "done" without evidence](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/ai-coding-agent-done-without-evidence/): An agent's "done" counts only if your checks ran after its last edit and can catch a real fault. Enforce it in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor.
- [App Store Reviews Scraper: any app, no Connect key](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/app-store-reviews-scraper/): Export Apple App Store reviews and app details for any app and country as JSON or CSV, from Apple's public feed. No Connect key. $0.20 per 1,000 rows.
- [Azure Content Moderator retirement 2027: drop-in API](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/azure-content-moderator-alternative/): Azure Content Moderator retires March 15, 2027; Content Safety is a different API. Keep ProcessText/Screen: same request and JSON, new host. $1 per 1,000.
- [Content Moderator to Content Safety: what changes](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/azure-content-moderator-to-content-safety/): Content Moderator retires in 2027. Field by field: ProcessText/Screen vs Content Safety text:analyze, plus where PII, video and human review go.
- [Check if an npm or PyPI Package Exists — API & MCP](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/check-npm-package-exists-api/): Confirms an npm or PyPI package exists, and a function or method exists in your exact pinned version, before an AI agent installs or calls it. MCP or REST.
- [Extract All URLs From a Sitemap — indexes, gzip, robots.txt](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/extract-urls-from-sitemap/): Read a site's public sitemap, including sitemap indexes and gzip, and return one row per page URL. Filter by date or regex. $0.40 per 1,000 URLs.
- [Drop-in replacements for retiring APIs, plus data tools](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/): Keep code working after Perspective, Azure Content Moderator and whisper-1 shut down: same requests, same JSON. Plus App Store reviews and Woolworths data.
- [Which MCP server actually works today? How to check](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/mcp-server-reliability/): A registry listing proves an MCP server can be found, not that it works. Run one real tool call, record the result, and keep "failed" apart from "not observed".
- [whisper-1 and gpt-4o-transcribe removed Feb 26, 2027](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/openai-transcription-models-deprecation-2027/): whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize leave the OpenAI API on Feb 26, 2027 — which replacement to pick.
- [PDF to Markdown API for RAG — DOCX & HTML too](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/pdf-to-markdown-api/): Convert public PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT and Markdown URLs into Markdown and overlapping RAG chunks. Arabic text support, no OCR. $0.0045 per converted page.
- [Perspective API shutdown (Dec 31, 2026): drop-in replacement](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/perspective-api-alternative/): Yes, Google's Perspective API shuts down after Dec 31, 2026, with no migration path. Keep the same comments:analyze request: change host and key. $1/1,000.
- [Perspective API shutdown: replacement checklist (2026)](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/perspective-api-shutdown-checklist/): Perspective API ends after Dec 31, 2026. Inventory every call, pick a replacement, shadow-test thresholds and cut over before the deadline.
- [Transcribe Audio URL to SRT — Whisper Speech to Text](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/transcribe-audio-url-to-srt/): Transcribe audio and video files from direct URLs into text, timed segments, SRT and VTT subtitles. 99 languages, open-source Whisper. From $0.006 per minute.
- [tts-1 alternative: migrate before January 6, 2027](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/tts-1-alternative/): OpenAI removes tts-1, tts-1-hd and gpt-4o-mini-tts on 6 Jan 2027. Keep POST /v1/audio/speech with independent local voices, from $0.009 per 1,000 characters.
- [whisper-1 removed Feb 26, 2027: keep SRT, VTT, timestamps](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/whisper-1-alternative/): Yes, OpenAI removes whisper-1 on Feb 26, 2027. Keep /v1/audio/transcriptions with SRT, VTT and word timestamps: change base_url and api_key. $0.006 per minute.
- [Does whisper-1 retirement break SRT and VTT output?](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/whisper-1-retirement-srt-vtt/): whisper-1 is removed Feb 26, 2027. OpenAI documents SRT, VTT and word timestamps for whisper-1 only. Test them on gpt-transcribe or keep a compatible endpoint.
- [Woolworths API: Australian grocery prices as JSON](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/woolworths-api/): Woolworths Australia product prices, specials and unit prices (per kg or litre) by search term, as JSON or CSV. Public catalog data. $1 per 1,000 items.
